notes.title: Luster 1.1 version Update
notes.content:
[h2]Unfamiliar with the adult game review mechanism at the beginning, and made the following changes based on relevant comments in player reviews:[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3] Remove all cover on CG[/h3]
[*] [h3]Change the way the mouse moves the element to drag[/h3]
[*] [h3]Make the last level easy[/h3]
[/list]
[h2]This is our first attempt at an adult game.
The unfamiliarity with the censorship mechanism and the conservative content of the game make the player's initial gaming experience unpleasant, 
[b]Thank you very much for playing the game![/b][/h2]
